message.reasoning:
We need to write formative feedback for a student based on marking. Need to produce JSON object only. Schema: summary <=80 words, next_steps array of 3 strings, criteria object mapping criterion id to feedback <=70 words each. Address student as "you". Be specific, supportive, actionable: cite sections/figures, name what they did well, state what next rubric level requires. Do not change marks. Do not comment on document-conversion artefacts. Do not make up explanations for reasoning given by marking agent that is unclear/incomplete.

We need craft feedback per criterion C1-C4. Also summary and next_steps. Need ensure no markdown, one JSON object only. Need not include marks? We can mention current level? We should not change marks. We can reference rubric levels. Need be supportive. Need cite sections/figures. Need mention what next rubric level requires. For C1: Accomplished 8/10. Feedback: strong mission concept and rationale, clear users and need, good references. To reach higher Accomplished (or full) need explicit quantitative mission objectives/requirements. Since already Accomplished, next level? Rubric only Accomplished max 10; next rubric level maybe higher within Accomplished? We can say "to strengthen within Accomplished, state explicit quantitative objectives/requirements". But "next rubric level requires" maybe for C2/C3. For C1, they are Accomplished; next level is not defined beyond. We can say "to secure the top of Accomplished, add explicit quantitative mission objectives and requirements." That's actionable.

C2: Adequate 6/10. Need next rubric level Accomplished requires robust plan with provision for variations/contingencies, clear why plan developed this way in context of mission, appropriate references to information sources. Also fix inconsistency Weeks 7/8 vs Gantt Weeks 9-10, add explicit planned information-source list. Cite Project Plan & Preliminary Progress and Image 1. Supportive: Gantt and task descriptions make plan credible. Need mention contingency and planned sources. Also editing timeline inconsistency. Good.

C3: Adequate 4/10. Need next level Accomplished requires good preliminary set of results with brief description/interpretation, clearly on track. Current: STK tutorials 1-4, background research, no design calculations/simulation outputs. Major error GEO at 600 km. Need correct orbit statement, present preliminary orbital calculations/COE/AOE or STK outputs. Cite Orbit Specifics and STK Design. Be careful: "Do not make up explanations for reasoning given by marking agent, that is unclear or incomplete." We can state what marking says. Good.

C4: Accomplished 8/10. Well structured, readable, footnotes, Gantt legible/explained. To strengthen within Accomplished: minor formatting/figure-detail issues; ensure all figures/tables fully labelled and consistent. Next rubric level? Already Accomplished. We can say "to reach the top of Accomplished, polish figure details and formatting consistency." Good.

Summary <=80 words: mention strong concept and presentation; plan credible but lacks contingency/planned sources and has timeline inconsistency; preliminary technical work thin and GEO altitude error; next steps. Need address student as "you". Keep <=80 words. Count words. Need one JSON object only.

Next_steps array of 3 strings. Should be actionable. Maybe:
1. "Correct the orbit statement in Orbit Specifics: a geostationary orbit is ~35,786 km, not 600 km; then add preliminary orbital calculations or STK outputs (COE/AOE) to show technical progress."
2. "Revise Project Plan & Preliminary Progress: add an explicit planned information-source list, include contingency/variation provisions, and align the text (Weeks 7–8 editing) with the Gantt (Weeks 9–10)."
3. "Strengthen Mission Concept & Rationale by stating explicit quantitative mission objectives/requirements, and polish figure/table formatting in the report to secure top presentation marks."

Need ensure each criterion feedback <=70 words. Let's draft.

C1 feedback: "Your Mission Concept & Rationale is strong: you clearly identify coral-reef monitoring users and the need for near-real-time relay, with relevant references. To secure the top of Accomplished, add explicit quantitative mission objectives and requirements (e.g., spatial resolution, revisit time, data latency) so the mission function is measurable." Count ~50 words. Good.

C2: "Your Gantt chart and task descriptions in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress make the plan credible. To reach Accomplished, add explicit contingency/variation provisions, a planned information-source list, and explain why the plan fits the mission concept. Also fix the inconsistency: text reserves Weeks 7–8 for editing/finalisation, but Image 1 shows Weeks 9–10." ~55 words. Good.

C3: "You completed STK tutorials 1–4 and background research, but preliminary technical work is thin. To reach Accomplished, present a good preliminary set of results with brief interpretation—e.g., orbital calculations, COE/AOE results or STK simulation outputs. Correct the Orbit Specifics error: GEO is ~35,786 km, not 600 km; 600 km is LEO and cannot stay fixed over the reef." ~60 words. Good.

C4: "Your report is well structured and readable, with footnotes and a legible, explained Gantt chart in Image 1. To secure the top of Accomplished, polish minor formatting and figure-detail issues so all graphical/table presentation is fully consistent and clear." ~40 words. Good.

Summary: "Your mission concept and presentation are strong, and your Gantt-based plan is credible. However, the plan lacks contingency and a planned information-source list, and the editing timeline is inconsistent. Preliminary technical work is thin, and the GEO-at-600-km statement is a major error. Address these to raise C2 and C3." Count ~50 words. Good.

Need JSON only. Ensure valid JSON. Use double quotes. No markdown. Criteria keys "C1" etc. Summary <=80 words. Next_steps exactly 3 strings. Good.

Need maybe mention "do not change marks" no marks included? We can mention levels but not marks? It's okay. We should not include numeric marks? The schema doesn't require marks. We can mention "Adequate" etc. Fine.

Need ensure no document-conversion artefacts. We mention Image 1 as figure. Good.

Need not make up explanations. We use marking evidence. Good.

Final JSON.
